title: The Strange Case of Robbers Cave
desc: In the summer of 1954, twenty two boys arrived at a camp in Oklahoma, not knowing that the adults around them were running an experiment. Tonight, we'll open the case file of the Robbers Cave study step by step: how strangers became a team, how two teams became rivals, what brought them back together, and the earlier camp that almost nobody heard about for decades.
plan: b01: cold open at the camp; Sherif's question; choosing 22 similar boys; deception; stage one, Eagles and Rattlers form; rivalry before any prize (open loops: was it natural? the 1953 camp)
b02: stage two tournament, prizes, realistic conflict theory, flag burning, rigged picnic, rigged win, cabin raid, in-group/out-group ratings, Brown 1986 quote, contact alone fails

b03: superordinate goals (water, film, truck), ~2 in 3 cross-group friendships, one bus; Middle Grove 1953 collapse (pays loop); criticisms, Tajfel & Turner 1979, Paluck et al. 2019, Tyerman & Spencer 1983, Wetherell 1982; takeaways, jigsaw classroom; callback; end
